summary.oneLiner: Knack Packaging is an integrated, export-led manufacturer of printed and laminated woven polypropylene (PLWPP) bulk packaging bags, holding ~10.1% share of the Indian flexible bulk PLWPP bag market (FY2025).
summary.business: Knack Packaging designs and manufactures customized, high-strength PLWPP woven bags and PLWPP pinch bottom bags (5kg-50kg) for food, pet food, agriculture, chemicals, building materials and other bulk applications, under a B2B2C model. It is vertically integrated from PP granule processing through tapes, fabric, printing, lamination to finished bags, and is the first company in India (and Asia) to integrate laser-cut easy-open features into PLWPP pinch bottom bags. It exports to 71 countries.
